explication: Pocket ID is a self-hosted OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 provider whose user sign-in is passkey-only. Users authenticate and manage their accounts in the web app; relying applications use the OIDC endpoints to request authorization and receive tokens and user claims. Administrators configure clients, users, groups, and application settings. The tree also shows user provisioning integrations and file storage. The sampled code supports the client-management and authorization links; broader subsystem links reflect documented product purpose and module boundaries, not inspected internal call paths.
